Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Atualização de Corrente de Maré?

In this glossary, Atualização de Corrente de Maré refers to: New information on rate and set of tidal current issued by VTS or hydrographic authority for local area.

How is Atualização de Corrente de Maré used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Solent VTS, solicito atualização mais recente de corrente de maré para trânsito leste no Canal Nab, calado onze metros, velocidade oito nós."

Why does Atualização de Corrente de Maré matter in maritime?

Atualização de Corrente de Maré matters because it supports clear communication in Meteorology contexts for Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as STCW, Marlins Test, ISF Watchkeeper, and GMDSS.

Who uses Atualização de Corrente de Maré?

Atualização de Corrente de Maré is mainly used by Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters.

What category does Atualização de Corrente de Maré belong to?

In this glossary, Atualização de Corrente de Maré is grouped under Meteorology. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from IMO SMCP, STCW Convention, SOLAS, COLREG and published by Protermify Maritime as a static maritime reference page.

Definition

New information on rate and set of tidal current issued by VTS or hydrographic authority for local area.

Operational example

Solent VTS, request latest tidal stream update for Nab Channel eastbound transit, draft eleven metres, speed eight knots.

Localized term

Atualização de Corrente de Maré

Localized example

Solent VTS, solicito atualização mais recente de corrente de maré para trânsito leste no Canal Nab, calado onze metros, velocidade oito nós.
